text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali meets Justice Minister Kallel on plans to reform justice to adapt to new economic environment.
- President receives report from Prime Minister Karoui on his meeting
with businessmen on occasion of 18th session of International Fair of Sousse, which opened at weekend.
- Tunisian embassies abroad told to focus on economic cooperation.
- 600 European and Mediterranean firms expected to be represented at Mediterranean partnership meeting (Med-Partenariat) in Tunis from September 24-26.
